title: The Portrait of Ashcombe
author: Ulyana Halloran
blurb: Wren Voss, a small-town coroner who knows every grave by name, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
